recommendation.what_happened: Quality event QE-2091 triggered a quarantine of CX-17 Power Relay lot FT-6602 from Ferrotek Components on August 11th, causing Plant 2's PX-440 Motor Controller throughput to drop 22% below normal.
recommendation.why: The PX-440 Motor Controller production depends directly on the CX-17 Power Relay, and the quarantine blocked supply of this critical component due to solder-joint defects causing elevated failure rates in lot FT-6602.
recommendation.impact: SO-45821 is at risk of missing its September 3 due date because reduced throughput on the PX-440 Motor Controller line limits fulfillment capacity for orders.
recommendation.recommendation: Expedite qualification of Meridian Circuit Supply's alternate CX-17 Power Relay lot (available within 5 business days) to restore Plant 2 throughput and protect order SO-45821's delivery schedule.

recommendation.why: The original CX-17 Power Relay lot FT-6602 from Ferrotek Components was quarantined due to a solder-joint defect and remained unavailable because Ferrotek's production line had its ISO 9001 certification on hold; Meridian's qualified alternative resolved the supply chain blockage.
recommendation.impact: The approval of Meridian's qualification lot restored the supply of CX-17 Power Relays, enabling Plant 2 to resume normal throughput on the PX-440 Motor Controller line and allowing Order SO-45821 to meet its September 3 due date.
recommendation.recommendation: Document the approval authority for Meridian's qualification lot and establish Meridian as a qualified secondary supplier for the CX-17 Power Relay to prevent future single-source supply risks.
